apiKey.//cacheVar: Optional, works with any source. When this variable holds a non-empty value it is used and the source is never touched, so a shell session pays one Touch ID prompt instead of one per command. Seed it with: export FELLOW_API_KEY="$(op read 'op://Vault/Fellow API key/credential')". Name it what the env source below uses, so switching between them is a source edit and not a rename.

credentials.//alternatives: Replace the apiKey object above with any one of these (each also accepts cacheVar):

//projects: Named scopes. Filtering applies automatically when defaultProject is set; --all-meetings turns it off. A plain string matches as a substring; wrap in /slashes/ for a regex.

acme.label: Acme Corp engagement
acme.//people: Attendee emails or domains. A client domain is often the single most reliable signal.
acme.//fallback: What to do when nothing matches: undecided (default), include, or exclude.

//series: Machine-maintained by `project classify` — do not hand-edit except to correct a verdict. Keyed by calendar series, so one entry covers every occurrence of a recurring meeting. project:null means 'belongs to no configured project'.
